title: The Firefly Bridge
description: Mila and Pipo help a hedgehog cross a stream and learn when to step back and wait.

cover.alt: Mila, Pipo and a hedgehog beside a bark bridge lit by fireflies.

illustration.alt: Mila and Pipo walk among fireflies and find a hedgehog beside a stream with no bridge.

blocks.title: Lights along the path
lines: Mila took a sunset walk with her little dragon, Pipo.
Fireflies glowed above the flowers.

blocks.title: A missing bridge
lines: A hedgehog waited beside the stream.
The rain had washed its bridge away.

variants.prompt: Which animal waits by the stream?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! A hedgehog is waiting beside the water.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for the little animal with prickles on its back.

variants.prompt: Why could the hedgehog not cross?

options.text: The rain washed the bridge away

variants.correctFeedback: That’s right: the rain carried the bridge away.
variants.retryFeedback: Read what the rain did, then look at the wet twigs.

illustration.alt: A leaf bends over the water and Pipo cannot move a heavy branch.

blocks.title: The leaf bends
lines: Mila laid a big leaf across the water.
The leaf bent in the middle.

blocks.title: A heavy branch
lines: Pipo tried to push a branch.
It was much too heavy for him.

variants.prompt: What is Pipo trying to move?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! Pipo is trying to move a branch.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at what Pipo is pushing with his front paws.

variants.prompt: Why did the leaf and branch not work?

options.text: The leaf bent and the branch was too heavy

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: they needed something firm that they could move.
variants.retryFeedback: Compare what happened to the leaf with Pipo’s effort to push the branch.

illustration.alt: Mila chooses bark and stones and builds a small crossing over the stream.

blocks.title: Bark and two stones
lines: Mila found a wide piece of bark and two stones.
They looked strong.

blocks.title: A new bridge
lines: She rested the bark on the two stones.
Now they had a bridge.

variants.correctFeedback: Yes! A stone holds up each end.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at the grey objects underneath the bark.

variants.prompt: Why did Mila put the stones there?

options.text: To hold the bark above the water

variants.correctFeedback: That’s right: the stones keep the bark above the water.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at the ends of the bark and the water flowing below.

illustration.alt: Mila tests the bridge with a pebble and notices the hedgehog hesitating at the entrance.

blocks.title: Testing the bridge
lines: Mila tested the bridge with a little pebble.
The bark stayed above the water.

blocks.title: The hedgehog waits
lines: The hedgehog did not move.
Mila and Pipo were standing too close.

variants.prompt: What did Mila put on the bridge?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! She tested it with a little pebble.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for the small grey object Mila places on the bark.

variants.prompt: Why did Mila test the bridge first?

options.text: That the bridge would stay steady
That Pipo could learn to swim
That the fireflies would stop glowing

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: she wanted to see whether the bark would hold steady.
variants.retryFeedback: Read what Mila watched for when she put weight on the bridge.

illustration.alt: Mila and Pipo step back as fireflies glow and the hedgehog crosses the bridge.

blocks.title: Room to move
lines: The friends stepped back to give it room.
Fireflies shone over the path.

blocks.title: Across at last
lines: The hedgehog crossed slowly.
Mila smiled: helping could also mean waiting.

variants.correctFeedback: Yes! The hedgehog can continue its walk.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for the little animal with prickles on the bridge.

variants.prompt: What did the friends do to let it pass?
variants.correctFeedback: That’s right: giving it space and time was another way to help.
variants.retryFeedback: Compare where Mila and Pipo stood before and after they stepped back.

dragon.definition: An imaginary animal that may have wings.

fireflies.definition: Small insects that make their own light.

hedgehog.definition: A small animal with prickles on its back.

waiting.definition: Letting some time pass before you act.
